headline: MiMo V2.6 Pro and Flash join AnyRouter with a 1.1M-token window
share: Xiaomi's MiMo V2.6 Pro and Flash are on AnyRouter, both with a 1.1M-token context window. Pro is $0.48 in and $0.96 out; Flash is $0.15 in and $0.31 out. Mistral Small 3.2 24B and two BGE embedding models were added in the same drop.
rationale: The MiMo V2.6 pair is the only new release in this drop and the only 1M-class context. Pro leads as Xiaomi's flagship, Flash follows as its cheaper sibling. Mistral Small 3.2 is a known open-weight model worth its own card. The two BGE embedding models are useful but not the story; the film counts them as +2 and the share copy names them.
